name: Highway 101 Expansion Phase 1
description: Expand Highway 101 by 50 miles to improve traffic flow and reduce congestion in the Northern District. Includes new interchanges and bridges.

name: School Modernization Program
description: Upgrade 20 schools with new technology, improved facilities, and energy-efficient systems across the Central District.

name: Regional Water Treatment Plant
description: Build a new water treatment facility to serve the Central District's growing population of 500,000 residents.

name: Metro Line Extension
description: Extend the downtown metro line by 10 stations to serve the Eastern District's underserved neighborhoods.

name: Community Health Center Network
description: Establish 15 new community health centers across the Southern District to improve healthcare access.

name: Solar Farm Initiative
description: Develop a 100MW solar farm to power government facilities and reduce carbon emissions in the Western District.

name: Smart City Pilot Program
description: Implement smart city technologies including IoT sensors, traffic management, and digital services in the Mountain District.

name: Bridge Safety Renovation
description: Renovate and reinforce 25 aging bridges across the Great Lakes District to ensure public safety.

name: Urban Housing Development
description: Construct 500 affordable housing units in the Mid-Atlantic District to address housing shortage.

name: Digital Government Services
description: Modernize government services with online portals, mobile apps, and digital ID systems statewide.
